info.title: App Management API
info.description: REST API for managing Adobe Commerce App Builder apps: resolving app configuration, managing configuration values, running the installation, upgrade, and uninstallation lifecycle, and managing the scope tree.

get.description: Returns the Commerce App configuration after resolving and validating it against the schema. When `commerceEnv` is provided, webhooks and events are filtered to that Commerce environment; when omitted, the full, unfiltered configuration is returned.

parameters.name: commerceEnv
parameters.description: When provided, filters the returned webhooks and events to those applicable to this Commerce environment. When omitted, the full configuration is returned.

parameters.name: x-gw-ims-org-id
parameters.description: Adobe IMS organization ID that identifies the organization for the request.

200.description: The resolved and validated Commerce App configuration.

upgradeMode.description: Controls upgrade execution after a deploy: "auto" runs the planned upgrade immediately, while "manual" returns the plan without executing it. Defaults to "auto".

adminUi.description: The Admin UI SDK v2 configuration block (served as the `adminUi` property of the app-config response).

openApiSpecUrl.description: URL of the OpenAPI spec for this deployment, scoped to the active capabilities. Includes a content-addressed cache key as a query parameter.

401.description: You are not authorized to access this resource. Ensure the IMS token and the x-gw-ims-org-id header are correctly set and valid.

403.description: The access token is valid, but it is not allowed to access the requested organization or operation.

401.description: You are not authorized to access this resource. Ensure the IMS token and the x-gw-ims-org-id header are correctly set and valid.

403.description: The access token is valid, but it is not allowed to access the requested organization or operation.

patch.description: Partially updates configuration values for a scope. Unsets those values that are sent with a null value.

200.description: The configuration values were successfully updated. Returns the updated configuration with password fields masked.

400.description: The request is invalid or could not be parsed.

get.description: Returns the status of the latest lifecycle attempt, whatever its operation. Without one, returns the installation record of an older library version, if any.

parameters.name: x-gw-ims-org-id
parameters.description: Adobe IMS organization ID that identifies the organization for the request.

parameters.name: x-aio-commerce-installation-invocation-source
parameters.description: Identifies the source of the request. When set to `post-app-deploy` and no lifecycle attempt exists, returns `204` instead of an older library version's installation record.

200.description: The latest lifecycle attempt, or the installation record of an older library version.

204.description: No installation workflow state or lifecycle attempt has been stored yet.

401.description: You are not authorized to access this resource. Ensure the IMS token and the x-gw-ims-org-id header are correctly set and valid.

403.description: The access token is valid, but it is not allowed to access the requested organization or operation.

post.description: Starts the pending plan named by `planId`, whatever its operation (install, upgrade or uninstall). Get the plan from `POST /installation/plan`. The plan is made again from the current state before it starts, and the attempt records how it differs from the reviewed plan in `review`.

parameters.name: x-gw-ims-org-id
parameters.description: Adobe IMS organization ID that identifies the organization for the request.

parameters.name: x-aio-commerce-installation-invocation-source
parameters.description: Identifies the source of the request. The generated post-deploy hook sends `post-app-deploy`; when that source is present and the app is not installed, reconciliation returns `409 not-installed` instead of starting a first-time installation.

202.description: The plan started. Poll `GET /installation` for its status.

activationId.description: The activation id of the background execution.

400.description: The request is invalid, for example without a `planId`.

401.description: You are not authorized to access this resource. Ensure the IMS token and the x-gw-ims-org-id header are correctly set and valid.

403.description: The access token is valid, but it is not allowed to access the requested organization or operation.

409.description: The plan cannot start. `reason` tells why: `in-progress` (another attempt is running; `attempt` carries its status), `stale-plan` (the `planId` is not the pending plan, or the installed state now calls for another operation; plan again), `not-associated`, `unreadable-state`, `baseline-missing` (the stored state names a baseline snapshot that no longer exists), `installed-without-config`, or `already-current`. Without a `reason`, planning is blocked by the `issues`, or the application ID changed.

post.description: Plans the install or upgrade the installed state calls for, or an uninstallation when `operation` is `uninstall`. Stores it as the pending plan and returns it for review, together with its issues as a validation result. Start it with `POST /installation` and its `id` as `planId`.

parameters.name: x-gw-ims-org-id
parameters.description: Adobe IMS organization ID that identifies the organization for the request.

200.description: The plan and its validation result.

400.description: The request is invalid or could not be parsed.

401.description: You are not authorized to access this resource. Ensure the IMS token and the x-gw-ims-org-id header are correctly set and valid.

403.description: The access token is valid, but it is not allowed to access the requested organization or operation.

409.description: Nothing was planned. `reason` tells why: `in-progress` (an attempt is running; `attempt` carries its status), `not-associated`, `unreadable-state`, `baseline-missing` (the stored state names a baseline snapshot that no longer exists), `installed-without-config`, or `already-current`. Without a `reason`, planning is blocked by the `issues`, or the application ID changed.

parameters.name: x-gw-ims-org-id

scopes.description: Custom scopes to store. Each code+level combination must be unique across the entire recursive tree.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents clients from caching custom scope tree mutation responses.

400.description: The request body is invalid: the scopes array is missing or not an array, a scope is missing a required field or has an invalid type, a scope uses a reserved code (commerce or global), or two scopes share the same code and level.

403.description: The access token is valid, but it is not allowed to access the requested organization or operation.

config.description: The validated app configuration recorded at install time. Present so uninstallation can be sourced from what was actually installed rather than the current request config. Absent on states persisted before this field was introduced.

The validated app configuration recorded at install time. Present so uninstallation can be sourced from what was actually installed rather than the current request config. Absent on states persisted before this field was introduced.

The validated app configuration recorded at install time. Present so uninstallation can be sourced from what was actually installed rather than the current request config. Absent on states persisted before this field was introduced.

operation.description: Set to `uninstall` to plan an uninstallation. Without it, `POST /installation/plan` plans the install or upgrade the installed state calls for.

planId.description: The id of the pending plan to start. Required by `POST /installation`.

LifecycleAttemptStatus.description: The status of a lifecycle attempt. Only one lifecycle operation runs at a time; `id` identifies the run.

completedAt.description: Present once the attempt succeeded or failed.

review.description: How the started plan differs from the reviewed one. Present when the attempt started from a reviewed plan.

blocking.description: Whether the issue prevents the plan from running.

PlanPreview.description: A lifecycle plan for review, without internal or sensitive values.

id.description: The `planId` to start the plan with.

reason.description: `change` when the config changed, `drift` when the live state differs from what was installed.

imsOAuth.description: Adobe IMS OAuth 2.0 access token. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <IMS access token>.

scopes.AdobeID: Identifies the user with their Adobe ID
scopes.openid: Authenticates the user via OpenID Connect
